name: voitta-desktop-audit
prompts: Read proxy/server.py in full. In at most 4 lines: what does _dump_failure name the files it writes, and what does it do when the name is taken?
Read middleware/tracker.py in full. In at most 4 lines: which numbers does the 'tokens |' log line report?
Read middleware/parsing.py in full. In at most 4 lines: which function parses an SSE stream, and which SSE event types does it take usage from?
Read mcpproxy/server.py in full. In at most 4 lines: what are ToolGateMiddleware.ANSWER_TTL_S and MAX_REMEMBERED, and what does Cancel in the gate popup do to the tool list?
Read mcpproxy/resilient.py in full. In at most 4 lines: what are LISTING_TIMEOUT_S and LISTING_FIRST_FILL_TIMEOUT_S, and when does each apply?
Read every .py file in optimizers/. As a list: each optimizer class, its chart_key, and whether emits_refs is True.
Read config.py in full. In at most 4 lines: the defaults for tool_result_keep_turns, image_keep_turns, thinking_keep_turns and tool_use_ref_min_chars.

Answer from what you read earlier in this session, re-reading only if you no longer have it: (a) the file name pattern _dump_failure uses, and (b) the value of ToolGateMiddleware.ANSWER_TTL_S. At most 3 lines.
